title: Sky Scene 6 — Travelling Through the Sky
purpose: Travelling movement, direction language and linked sky description.

sentenceModels: The airplane is flying across the sky.
The helicopter is flying on the right.
The balloon is floating in the middle.
The kite is near the rainbow.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about where things are moving in the sky and describe the whole scene.
starterPrompts: What is flying on the left?
What is flying on the right?
How many birds can you see?
expansionPrompts: Can you tell the story from left to right?

visualAudit: One red airplane flying across the upper left.
One blue helicopter on the upper right.
One colourful balloon in the middle.
One kite near a rainbow and sun.
